limits: Bounded review adapter does not promote finite completion or assert all cards/interactions covered. Historical75baselines remain75;239primaryIDs implies164partial only if parent adopts exact metadata.
All336 original independent packets and source recipes must be archived with exact hashes; this adapter preserves original review scope and limitations rather than rewriting them.
Five four-live scenarios cover only their declared subject branches. Incidental Sigil/SpellFray or token/hero/support-card mentions do not inflate subject counts.
Existing earlyLPlegalplay case is reviewed only through valid announcement on Stack; its stale original pre-proof metadata is explicitly preserved.
Current full replay twice is verified here. Complete selected4 actual controls plus final77/default preservation and final metadata review remain separate gates.
